title: Full Coverage Customers
scenario: Find 'customer_id' who purchased every distinct 'product_key' available in the 'Product' table.
tableSchema: customer (customer_id INT, product_key INT), product (product_key INT)
hint: Count distinct products per customer and compare to total count in Product table.
correctQuery: SELECT customer_id FROM customer GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT product_key) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product);
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE customer (customer_id INT, product_key INT); CREATE TABLE product (product_key INT); INSERT INTO customer VALUES (1, 5), (2, 6), (1, 6); INSERT INTO product VALUES (5), (6);
